name: Default
shortDescription: Open source low-code platform for building internal tools, apps and dashboards, run as one all-in-one container with embedded MongoDB and Redis.

alerts.message: Sign in with the super admin account from LOWCODER_SUPERUSER_USERNAME and LOWCODER_SUPERUSER_PASSWORD. Email sign-up is open by default, so anyone who reaches the URL can register and create a workspace; set LOWCODER_EMAIL_SIGNUP_ENABLED to false to close it.
